generic.text: This situation involves competing obligations, so I would start by identifying everyone affected and what each person stands to gain or lose. I would consider the relevant duties, rights and likely consequences, look for an option that respects as many of these interests as possible, and weigh the risk of harm against the benefits. I would be honest and transparent about the reasons for my decision, take responsibility for its effects, and stay open to new information that could change my assessment. On balance, I would choose the option that best fits these considerations.
